name.zh: 东江纵队活动区域（宝安—惠阳）
name.en: Dongjiang Column area of operations (Bao'an–Huiyang)

description.zh: 示意东江纵队在宝安、惠阳一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Dongjiang Column around Bao'an and Huiyang; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江游击队进入大岭山
name.en: Dongjiang guerrillas enter Dalingshan

description.zh: 1940 年 10 月，东江抗日游击队一部进入东莞大岭山，开辟抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In October 1940, part of the Dongjiang guerrillas entered Dalingshan in Dongguan and opened a base area. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖独立总队转移美合
name.en: Qiongya Independent Corps moves to Meihe

description.zh: 1940 年 12 月，琼崖抗日独立总队转移至澄迈美合，随后遭国民党军袭击（美合事变）。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In December 1940 the Qiongya Independent Corps moved to Meihe in Chengmai and was then attacked by KMT forces (Meihe Incident). Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队活动区域（琼山—六连岭）
name.en: Qiongya Column area of operations (Qiongshan–Liulianling)

description.zh: 示意琼崖抗日武装在琼山、万宁六连岭一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Qiongya forces around Qiongshan and Liulianling in Wanning; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 珠江纵队活动区域（中山—五桂山）
name.en: Pearl River Column area of operations (Zhongshan–Wuguishan)

description.zh: 示意珠江地区抗日游击队在中山、五桂山一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Pearl River guerrillas around Zhongshan and Wuguishan; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江游击队营救文化名人（惠阳—香港）
name.en: Dongjiang guerrillas rescue cultural figures (Huiyang–Hong Kong)

description.zh: 1941 年 12 月香港沦陷后，东江游击队从惠阳方向进入香港，营救文化界人士和爱国民主人士。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: After Hong Kong fell in December 1941, Dongjiang guerrillas entered Hong Kong from the Huiyang direction to rescue cultural and patriotic democratic figures. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 港九大队活动区域（西贡—九龙）
name.en: Hong Kong–Kowloon Brigade area of operations (Sai Kung–Kowloon)

description.zh: 示意港九大队在西贡、九龙一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Hong Kong–Kowloon Brigade around Sai Kung and Kowloon; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队进入白沙
name.en: Qiongya Column enters Baisha

description.zh: 1943 年 8 月，琼崖纵队向白沙地区发展，开辟抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In August 1943 the Qiongya Column expanded into the Baisha area and opened a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队挺进五指山
name.en: Qiongya Column advances into Wuzhishan

description.zh: 1944 年 8 月，琼崖纵队由白沙向五指山山区发展，扩大抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In August 1944 the Qiongya Column expanded from Baisha into the Wuzhishan mountains. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 珠江纵队活动区域（五桂山—珠江口）
name.en: Pearl River Column area of operations (Wuguishan–Pearl River estuary)

description.zh: 示意珠江纵队在五桂山、珠江口一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Pearl River Column around Wuguishan and the Pearl River estuary; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队进入昌感
name.en: Qiongya Column enters Changgan

description.zh: 1944 年 12 月，琼崖纵队向昌江、感恩地区发展，建立抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In December 1944 the Qiongya Column expanded into the Changjiang–Gan’en area and established a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 韩江纵队活动区域（潮汕—韩江）
name.en: Hanjiang Column area of operations (Chaoshan–Han River)

description.zh: 示意韩江纵队在潮汕、韩江一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Hanjiang Column around Chaoshan and the Han River; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 南路人民抗日解放军活动区域（遂溪—雷州）
name.en: Nanlu People’s Anti-Japanese Army area of operations (Suixi–Leizhou)

description.zh: 示意南路人民抗日解放军在遂溪、雷州一带的活动区域，非单次行军路线。待史料校订。
description.en: Schematic area of operations of the Nanlu People’s Anti-Japanese Army around Suixi and Leizhou; not a single march. Pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江纵队移驻罗浮山
name.en: Dongjiang Column moves to Luofu Mountain

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月，东江纵队领导机关由惠阳一带移驻博罗罗浮山。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In January 1945 the Dongjiang Column leadership moved from the Huiyang area to Luofu Mountain in Boluo. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江纵队挺进粤北
name.en: Dongjiang Column advances into northern Guangdong

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月，东江纵队一部挺进粤北南雄一带，开辟抗日游击区。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In January 1945 part of the Dongjiang Column advanced into the Nanxiong area of northern Guangdong and opened a guerrilla area. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 珠江纵队挺进粤中
name.en: Pearl River Column advances into central Guangdong

description.zh: 1945 年 1 月，珠江纵队由五桂山向粤中新会一带发展，开辟抗日游击区。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In January 1945 the Pearl River Column expanded from Wuguishan into the Xinhui area of central Guangdong. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江纵队进入海陆丰
name.en: Dongjiang Column enters Haifeng–Lufeng

description.zh: 1945 年 3 月，东江纵队一部向海丰、陆丰地区发展，建立抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In March 1945 part of the Dongjiang Column expanded into the Haifeng–Lufeng area and established a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 珠江纵队挺进云雾山
name.en: Pearl River Column advances into Yunwu Mountain

description.zh: 1945 年 4 月，珠江纵队由粤中向云雾山一带发展，扩大抗日游击区。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In April 1945 the Pearl River Column expanded from central Guangdong into the Yunwu Mountain area. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 珠江纵队进入高要
name.en: Pearl River Column enters Gaoyao

description.zh: 1945 年 5 月，珠江纵队向高要一带发展，建立抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In May 1945 the Pearl River Column expanded into the Gaoyao area and established a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队进入临高
name.en: Qiongya Column enters Lingao

description.zh: 1945 年 5 月，琼崖纵队向临高地区发展，建立抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In May 1945 the Qiongya Column expanded into the Lingao area and established a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 琼崖纵队挺进尖峰岭
name.en: Qiongya Column advances into Jianfengling

description.zh: 1945 年 6 月，琼崖纵队由白沙向乐东尖峰岭山区发展，扩大抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In June 1945 the Qiongya Column expanded from Baisha into the Jianfengling mountains in Ledong. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.

name.zh: 东江纵队挺进粤赣湘边
name.en: Dongjiang Column advances into the Guangdong–Jiangxi–Hunan border

description.zh: 1945 年 7 月，东江纵队北上部队进入粤赣湘边和平一带，开辟抗日根据地。示意简化路线，待史料校订。
description.en: In July 1945 the Dongjiang Column’s northward units entered the Heping area on the Guangdong–Jiangxi–Hunan border and opened a base. Schematic simplified route; pending historical review.
